## AsrSession.onFinal() method

Subscribe to committed transcripts. Returns an unsubscribe function. Multiple subscribers are fine; each gets every event.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onFinal(callback: (event: AsrFinalEvent) => void): UnsubscribeFn;
```
